notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/b7e8f1d05f5a59c214a9791d2e2930b2ced11858.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]
- Improved performance
- Improved camera sensitivity options 
Fixed:
- A Bug that caused controller users to get stuck on the collectible
- Inversion of X and Y axis
- A bug that caused a player to move continuously in the direction that a player was moving before picking up the collectible
- A bug that caused very high mouse sensitivity upon starting the game

And we added two new birds (because why not?)

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40565061/8f19fb4503089f2de39487091c6dde33cc5a3f5d.png[/img]
[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

We have fixed a bug that prevented players from interacting with laser puzzle after loading a save file created after unlocking that very puzzle. This fix will affect saves created after this update.
